definitions.meaning: The start of a plant's life: it rests in the soil and wakes up with water, warmth and light, then sprouts a root and a shoot.
The baby plant that has just sprouted from a seed: it grows taller and stronger until it becomes an adult plant.
The showy part of the adult plant: new seeds form inside it, so it starts the next round of the cycle instead of ending it.
The growing-up stage of a butterfly: it hatches from an egg and munches leaves to grow bigger.
The resting case a caterpillar forms: inside it, the caterpillar's body changes into a butterfly.
The circle of changes a living thing goes through as it grows: the adult makes new young, and the circle starts again.

mechanismSteps: A seed wakes up and sprouts: the seed rests in the soil, and with water, warmth and light it wakes up, growing a root down and a green shoot up into a seedling.
Watch out: the flower is not the end of the plant: the seedling grows into an adult plant with a flower, and inside the flower new seeds are forming, ready to start the cycle again.
An egg hatches into a caterpillar: a butterfly lays tiny eggs on a leaf, and each egg hatches into a caterpillar that munches leaves and grows bigger.
The butterfly emerges and the cycle repeats: the caterpillar rests inside a pupa while its body changes, then an adult butterfly emerges and lays eggs, so the cycle repeats.
objectives: Name the stages of a plant life cycle: seed, seedling, adult plant, flower, new seeds
Name the stages of a butterfly life cycle: egg, caterpillar, pupa, adult butterfly
Explain how new seeds forming inside a flower start the plant cycle again
Explain why the flower is not the end of the life of the plant
subject: science
title: Life cycles: plants and animals

trap.explanation: The flower is the biggest, showiest and last part to appear, so it looks like the finish. The flower is not the end: inside the flower new seeds are forming, and the cycle starts again. In the animation scene s2 the flower opens and new seeds are shown forming inside it, then falling to the soil - the start of the next round, not the finish.
trap.misconception: The flower is the end of the life of the plant.

workedExample: In scenes s1 and s2, follow one seed as a worked example: the seed wakes up in the soil and sprouts, so one seed becomes a seedling; the seedling grows into an adult plant with a flower, and inside that flower new seeds form. Each step is a change of state, and the new seeds can start the whole cycle again.
